# Install `empty-states` — Empty States

> Configurable EmptyState (composes shadcn Empty) with six per-kind presets plus a full-page ErrorPage drop-in for not-found/error routes.

📚 Knowledge base : https://resource.rahmanef.com/llms.txt
📦 Slice detail   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/slices/empty-states
🧠 JSON catalog   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/api/knowledge?slice=empty-states
🤖 Prompt page    : https://resource.rahmanef.com/agents/empty-states

## 1. Install

```bash
npx rahman-resources add empty-states
# alias: npx rr add empty-states
```

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `ui`, `empty-state`, `error-page`, `404`, `placeholder`, `fallback`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add empty-states`. `<EmptyState kind="no-results" />` renders a preset (icon + title + description) for one of `404 | 500 | 403 | no-results | empty-list | first-use`; override any of `icon` / `title` / `description` via props. Pass `primaryAction` / `secondaryAction` as `{ label, href?, onClick? }` — `href` renders a `<Button asChild><a>`, otherwise an `onClick` button. Use `<ErrorPage kind="404" .../>` as the full-page wrapper inside `app/not-found.tsx` and `app/error.tsx`; set `compact` for inline list placeholders.

## Rules of engagement

- shadcn-only UI primitives. No raw `<button>` / `<dialog>` / native date or file inputs.
- 200-line hard cap per source file (extract neighbours when over).
- All Convex queries hit an index (`.withIndex(...)`); never bare `.collect()`.
- Public mutations/queries declare `args:` validators + authz.
- Full ruleset: https://resource.rahmanef.com/best-practice
